migrationOrRollback: 0019 is additive (new tables, functions, triggers; no change to existing tables). Forward-only: before release, revert the M11 commits on a database that never ran 0019; once applied, ship a forward fix. 0019 was amended in place inside this unreleased branch for the S1-S3/S7 security fixes, the unsealed-digest split and the T-010 key shape, before any shared database applied it. Closeouts, milestones, evidence, assessments and attempts are append-only and must not be rewritten.
specAmbiguitiesResolved: Recovery policy is M11's own effective-dated table (site over tenant), not an M02 policy key; an evaluation is governed by the revision its milestone pinned (in force for the incident's scope at the observed time), so later revisions apply to later milestones only.

Approved action = an M10 order/job of the incident's EXECUTING/COMPLETED plan that has no definite-no-effect stamp and is not REJECTED/CANCELLED/FAILED; installed-part identity = the action candidate's manufacturer + MPN (or the plan's part-purchase action when the milestone names a service action), plus the purchase order VERIFIED.

Stable window duration = max(policy stableWindowMs, pinned rule recoveryWindowMs); safe range from the pinned incident rule (comparator, threshold, hysteresis); every pinned channel must hold the window.
Evaluation instant = database clock or a later asOf at most 1 h ahead (only stricter freshness / earlier expiry); future samples beyond 5 s are flagged.

Supersession (milestone/evidence/policy/channel binding change) FAILS the open evaluation with a *_SUPERSEDED reason and opens a new one without escalating; revoked binding, disputed evidence and expiry escalate.
CMMS work orders are keyed by the UptimeBuyer incident id; a CMMS integration is an M02 INTEGRATION identity bound to one site with a separate record-verifier secret.
Disputes by a human use M04's operator commands (escalateIncident / reopenIncident); the lost-signal sweep uses the new engine reopen.
securityReview: Forged/replayed signatures: CMMS HMAC over exact raw bytes, 300 s tolerance both ways, >= 32-byte keys, strict schema without tenant/URL fields, replay identity (tenant, integration, record id); authority-capable evidence and milestones sealed with the recovery keyring and re-verified before use.

Clock skew/backdating: policy future-skew and backdate bounds against database observed time, no work before the cycle entered EXECUTING, ingestion bounds +1 h/-30 d, asOf bounded to +1 h and stricter-only.

IDOR: every exported command authorizes against the resource's site inside its transaction; foreign/out-of-site ids are RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; CMMS integration site must equal the incident site (also by FK).

Races: incident -> evaluation -> evidence -> integration/role/membership lock order; one open evaluation and one PASSED per cycle; closeout uniqueness and the RECOVERED transition in one transaction; dispute and revocation races tested.
Fail-open on NULL/missing evidence: all 0019 guards NULL-safe (ADR 0004 tripwire), PASSED requires samples and every required signoff; the gate fails closed on disputed pinned evidence.
False proof: model/provider/receipt/free text refused by kind in SQL and code; boundary equality excluded; non-LIVE/flagged/simulated/sibling samples cannot be pinned.

FIXED S5 (84cbd53 / 59f01e0): operator-attested milestones survived attester role revocation; now re-checked at evaluation and closeout.
FIXED S6 (84cbd53 / 59f01e0): dispute receipt claimed the reopen before it committed; receipt now written after the durable effect, effects re-derived on replay, gate fails closed.
FIXED S7 (red 8100bd5, fix 7bc4382): PASSED ignored attester role revocation/membership suspension; now share-locked and re-checked; setMembershipStatus updates the locked row.
Self review: the jointly enforced T-010 sweep found missing (tenant_id, id) keys on four new tables (fixed); no further findings.
unresolvedRisks: The incidents table has no database trigger requiring a closeout for RECOVERED (M04 tests drive the hook with a test-only fake evaluator); the guarantee rests on the unexported hook, the lint boundary, the structural test and the closeout commit guard.
Engine workers can choose asOf up to 1 h ahead, which can expire an evaluation early (escalation only; workers can already escalate via advanceIncident).
Milestone and evidence seals use a runtime HMAC keyring; key rotation must keep retired keys in the ring to verify history.
Scheduling (monitorRecoveredIncidents, runCmmsWrites, the two outbox consumers, assessRecovery) must be wired by the deployment (M14); nothing runs on a timer.
The HTTPS CMMS adapter's request/response shape is illustrative and must be mapped to a real CMMS vendor before enabling.
Raw CMMS record bodies are stored in recovery_evidence without a retention/erasure worker (FR-23 belongs to M13/M02).
